type Identity<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] };
const uppercase: Readonly<Uppercase<string>> = 'AbC';
const template: Identity<`id-${string}`> = 'other';
const numericTemplate: Partial<`ref-${number}`> = 'ref-bad';
const capitalized: Capitalize<Lowercase<string>> = 'HELLO';
const recased: Uppercase<Lowercase<string>> = 'AbC';
const uncapitalized: Uncapitalize<Uppercase<string>> = 'abc';
const inside: `id-${Capitalize<Lowercase<string>>}` = 'id-WORLD';
